notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hello! After seeing some support I've worked to improve the game a bit,

- Movement speed and gravity increased, making matches more intense
- Improved knock-back
- Redone Shield : When hitting an opponent that is using shield, you will be knocked back
- Improved Siege lighting
- Improved Siege cannon ball movement and collision 

If you want the Rollers to continue growing, show some more support! Maybe I'll make the 5v5 mode

notes.title: New Movement System
notes.content:
First small update:

[list]
[*] Improved movement netcode. There should now be little to no "laggy" jitter.
[*] An unlimited players mode is on its way, but only for use on the map "Sea".
[*] Perk slots are still unfortunately bugged.

[/list]
